headline: Helzephyr dark flyer
title: Helzephyr | Flying Mount That Boosts Your Attack | Palworld Guide
video_script: A flying mount that makes you hit harder in Palworld one point zero? Helzephyr is a Dark Pal, and its partner skill, Wings of Death, lets you ride it, changes your attack type to Dark and raises your Attack by five to twenty percent while mounted. At base it works Transporting level four. Will you fly Helzephyr? Comment below!
description: Helzephyr in Palworld 1.0 is a Dark flying mount that boosts your Attack and works Transporting level four.
